name: Escape from Azkaban
text: [approach] From the coast, follow the north arm of the Coronation Glacier up.
[approach] The line starts where rock emerges from the ice on the glacier's north margin.
[descent_text] The way down from the top follows the rim of the canyon west and northwest, then descends into the upper end of the obvious river valley toward a tributary glacier.

[descent_text] Where that glacier meets the main glacier there is an impassable canyon, so the line returns uphill and handrails the cliff west of the tributary glacier above unstable ice-cored moraine.

name: Raise the Drawbridge!
text: [approach] Follow the north arm of the Coronation Glacier up.
[approach] The line starts where rock emerges from the ice on the glacier's north margin, and a water-filled moat separates the rock from the ice;

name: The Salami Exchange Commission
text: [approach] The route climbs the prominent ridge and buttress on the north side of the Coronation Glacier, just downstream of the split between its north and south arms.
[descent_text] A fourth-class chimney leads down through the cliff band, and from there the route exits back right out of the river valley onto the Coronation Glacier.
